MORE:
The Board at its meeting held today i.e. Thursday, November 12th, 2026, interalia, considered and approved the following:
1. Un-audited Financial Results for the Half Year ended 30.09.2026 along with Limited Review Report by Statutory Auditors i.e. M/s Agarwal R C & CO., Chartered Accountants, Mumbai.
2. Statement of Deviation(s) or Variation(s) in the utilisation of proceeds raised through the Initial Public Offer (IPO), along with the Certificate issued by the Statutory Auditors in this regard, was considered and taken on record.

HEADLINE: Diksha Polymers Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 12/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve 1. The Un-audited Financial ....
MORE:
Diksha Polymers Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 12/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve 1. The Un-audited Financial Results for the half year ended September 30th, 2026, along with Auditor's Limited Review Report thereon.
2. The Statement of Deviation(s) or Variation(s) in the utilisation of proceeds raised through the Initial Public Offer (IPO), along with the Certificate issued by the Statutory Auditors in this regard.
3. Any other business with the permission of the chair.
